'''''Gaudinia''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Mediterranean]] plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>[http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/gen00253.htm Grassbase - The World Online Grass Flora]</ref><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394174#page/179/mode/1up Palisot de Beauvois, Ambroise Marie François Joseph. 1812.  Essai d'une Nouvelle Agrostographie 95] in Latin</ref><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394174#page/304/mode/1up Palisot de Beauvois, Ambroise Marie François Joseph. 1812.  Essai d'une Nouvelle Agrostographie plate XIX (19), figure V (5 a-d)] line drawing of ''Gaudinia fragilis,'' [https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394174#page/279/mode/1up figure captions on caption page 13]</ref><ref>[[Stace, C. A.]] & T. G. Tutin. 1978. 'A new species of ''Gaudinia'' from Spain'. Bot. J. Linn. Soc. 76: 353–356</ref>

The genus name is a tribute to Swiss botanist [[Jean François Aimé Théophile Philippe Gaudin]] (1766-1833).

; Species<ref name=t>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=451535 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>[http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/search?q=Gaudinia The Plant List search for Gaudinia]</ref>
* ''[[Gaudinia coarctata]]'' - [[Azores]]
* ''[[Gaudinia fragilis]]'' - [[Mediterranean]] + nearby regions from [[Portugal]] + [[Morocco]] to [[Turkey]]
* ''[[Gaudinia hispanica]]''  - [[Spain]]
* ''[[Gaudinia maroccana]]'' - [[Morocco]]

; formerly included<ref name=t/>
see ''[[Helictochloa]] [[Ventenata]] '' 
* ''Gaudinia biebersteinii - [[Ventenata macra]]'' 
* ''Gaudinia fragilis - [[Ventenata macra]]'' 
* ''Gaudinia planiculmis - [[Helictochloa planiculmis]]'' 
* ''Gaudinia tenuis - [[Ventenata dubia]]''
